title: Apply the approved brand identity across the operations workspace
userStory: As a contract operations user, I can scan records and navigate workflows through a consistent, readable interface.
businessRules: Presentation changes preserve status meanings, values, permissions and event handlers.
nonGoals: No business logic, data changes, model calls or deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: See docs/design/WORKSPACE_VISUAL_REFRESH.md for visual and interaction acceptance.
